name: XSum
description: XSum (Extreme Summarization) is a news article summarization dataset where the task is to produce a single-sentence summary capturing the core news story. Each summary is the introductory sentence of a BBC article, creating highly abstractive single-sentence summaries that are more challenging than multi-sentence extractive summarization.
reputation: Standard benchmark for abstractive summarization; requires extreme abstraction (single sentence); widely used for evaluating seq2seq models and LLMs on summarization
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2018. Contains 226,711 news article-summary pairs from BBC. Training: 204,045; validation: 11,332; test: 11,334. The extreme abstraction requirement (one sentence) makes extractive approaches insufficient. Commonly used alongside CNN/DailyMail for summarization evaluation. LLMs with instruction tuning have substantially improved scores.
